records.title: Between Two Lovers (このごにおよんで愛など)
records.meta: Film · Japan / Taiwan · Japanese · drama · 128 min · written, directed and edited by Nanako Hirose · starring Masami Nagasawa as Uta Kojima, Tasuku Emoto as Morio Kojima, and Shizuka Ishibashi as Junna Kuramochi · produced and distributed by K2 Pictures · theatrical release 27 Nov 2026 · Japanese rating G
records.character: Uta Kojima (married picture-book author, also in a relationship with her editor); Junna Kuramochi (Uta's editor and lover, who becomes pregnant); Morio Kojima (Uta's husband)
records.summary: Picture-book author Uta has been married to Morio for three years and has also been seeing her editor, Junna, in secret. When both ask her to choose, she proposes that the three of them have a child and live together. As the household takes shape, their relationships change, and Junna becomes pregnant.
records.method: None — a three-person household formed by agreement, not hypnosis or occult control
records.evidence: Eiga.com and Cinema Today both state that after Uta, Morio, and Junna begin living together, Junna's pregnancy is revealed. The official K2 Pictures English announcement confirms the title Between Two Lovers, the 27 Nov 2026 theatrical date, director Nanako Hirose, and the husband-and-lover triad.
records.pregnancy_note: Junna, Uta's editor and lover, becomes pregnant after the three adults start living together. Official synopses do not describe a sex scene during the pregnancy. Partners in the household: Uta and Morio.
